Name: CS_TEXTURE_FILTER_QUALITY_DETAIL
Description: Texture filtering settings for each level of the Texture Quality option. Loaded from the system params, not regulation.bin. The first 5 rows in file order are the levels Off, Low, Medium, High and Maximum; row IDs are ignored and further rows are not read. The whole param is ignored if its data version is not 1.

Fields.Name: Texture Filter
Fields.Description: Filtering mode of the main texture samplers, 0–3; higher is better. Retail: 1 Off, 2 Low, 3 Medium and up.

Fields.Name: Maximum Anisotropy
Fields.Description: Maximum anisotropic filtering level of the main texture samplers. Retail: 1 Off and Low, 4 Medium, 8 High, 16 Maximum.
